Gene Atlas Human (GenAtHum) Data

Source: R/data.R
GenAtHum.Rd

The microarray data were obtained from the GDS DataSet of the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) repository in the NCBI archives.

Format

A list of length 6 containing:

X

Design matrix of dimension 158 x 2045.

y

Response vector of length 158.

group

Group membership code for each predictor.

gene_code

Vector of gene codes.

gene_name

Vector of gene names.

groups_name

Vector of group names.

Source

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/

Details

This data set contains 158 samples, 2045 predictors, and 79 groups, as described in Yuzbasi and Cao (2025).

Examples

data(GenAtHum)
X <- GenAtHum$X
y <- GenAtHum$y
group <- GenAtHum$group
